purpose: Teach: 念仏/党派/連隊/中退/白血病/リンパ/邁進/衰弱

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、念仏のような企業理念を社員に唱えさせるな
lines.en: Don't make our company recite some hollow corporate creed like a mantra.
lines.style: Sharp, clipped consonants. No warmth. A directive stated as fact—this is what will not happen. Direct eye contact, settled posture. Quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。特定の党派と組まないようにします
lines.en: Understood. We'll make sure we don't align with any particular political faction.
lines.style: Measured, respectful affirmation. He's noting the instruction and committing internally. Slight bow of the head. Steady, attentive—no rushing, no hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新事業部隊を連隊のように組織しろ
lines.en: Organize our new business division with the discipline and structure of a regiment.
lines.style: Authoritative and methodical. Each phrase lands with weight. Speaks as though seeing the structure already in place. Calm but commanding—not loud, but impossible to ignore.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中退社員の復職プログラムを準備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll put together a rehiring program for employees who left early.
lines.style: Confirmation with quiet intent. He's already thinking through logistics. Clear, grounded tone—no uncertainty. A brief nod. He'll follow through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、白血病社員の支援制度を整備しろ
lines.en: Set up proper support systems for employees facing leukemia.
lines.style: Tone shifts to something quieter, more deliberate. This directive carries different weight—not strategy, but care. Spoken with the same authority but a steadier undercurrent of responsibility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。リンパ浮腫の労災事例を社員に周知します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure staff are informed about lymphedema and workers' compensation procedures.
lines.style: Careful, precise. He understands the gravity. Speaks with quiet competence—this is about employees, not metrics. No rush. Fully present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界トップに邁進しろ
lines.en: Drive this company to the top of the industry.
lines.style: Returns to commanding tone but with settled confidence. Not a shout—a statement of direction. The kind of brief, clear mandate that ends a meeting. Lean back slightly, finished.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。衰弱した取引先には支援的対応をします
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we respond with support to business partners that are struggling.
lines.style: Final affirmation, closing the meeting. Reflects his boss's values back with his own commitment. Steady, sincere—he means it. Slight pause before speaking, showing he's absorbed everything.
